facts.fact: Nigeria licensed Starlink as an ISP early, on a 10-year licence, for about $500 in fees (per BusinessDay); the licence date is not given.

Starlink had about 65,564 active subscribers in Nigeria in late 2024 into 2025, at about N56,000-N57,000 a month residential and N150,000+ business; residential sales paused in parts of Lagos and Abuja for congestion. Date taken from the article.

note: Licence date not given; as_of is the article date (day unconfirmed). Subscriber as_of is approximate.
